name: Buyline
tagline: What’s actually happening inside B2B buying decisions.
description: Company deep dives and essays for the people who own B2B pipeline: how buyers decide, where pipeline breaks, and which decisions move revenue.
intro: When pipeline slows down, most teams blame the channel. They raise the budget, change agencies, or try new ads. But the problem usually starts somewhere else, in how buyers make up their minds or in what happens after someone asks to talk.
signupHeadline: Turn more of your marketing into pipeline.
signupText: Company deep dives and essays on what actually moves B2B buyers, from positioning to paid, so you can make the calls that grow revenue.
